انتقين (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَيْنَ (intaqayna) /in.ta.qaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اُنْتُقِينَ (untuqīna) /un.tu.qiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# اِنْتَقِينَ (intaqīna) /in.ta.qiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
